steps.title: Register
steps.desc: Sign up in minutes. Enter your name, email, country and create a password.

steps.title: Subscribe
steps.desc: Choose a monthly or annual plan. UK members pay via Stripe, Nigerian members via Flutterwave.
details: Secure payment via Stripe or Flutterwave

steps.title: Create or Join a Group
steps.desc: Start your own rotating savings group or join an existing one. Set contribution amounts, group size and payout order.
details: Create a group with custom rules
Or join an existing group via invite link

steps.title: Contribute Monthly
steps.desc: Make your scheduled contribution each month. Every on-time payment builds your Trust Score™.
details: Receive payment reminders before each due date
Pay securely via Stripe or Flutterwave

steps.title: Track Progress
steps.desc: See the full rotation schedule, upcoming payouts and your group's payment history at a glance.
details: View rotation order and upcoming payouts

steps.title: Receive Your Payout
steps.desc: When it's your turn in the rotation, receive the full group payout directly to your bank account.
details: Automatic payout when all contributions received
Paid directly to your registered bank account
